use_when.text: Use Logo/Symbol on its own for the app icon and favicon.

placement.text: Sidebar header when collapsed, Color Brand, Size Small, above the expand Icon Button.

a11y.text: By default renders a <span> with role="img" and aria-label "Lemonade Found".
When aria-hidden is passed, the span is aria-hidden="true" and gets no role or label, so it is decorative.
The inner SVG is aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false".

gaps.detail: The Logo documentation page (23:946), which holds the Logo/Symbol set, has no "Do not" rule that names Logo/Symbol (checked usage region 23:1138, rules 23:1178).
Color=Brand, Black, White: the Logo documentation page (23:946), which holds the Logo/Symbol set does not say what these values are for (checked usage region 23:1138).
Size=Small, Medium, Large: the Logo documentation page (23:946), which holds the Logo/Symbol set does not say what these values are for (checked usage region 23:1138).
Logo/Symbol composes no other component and no story pairs it with a sibling component.
The Logo documentation page has no accessibility note specific to Logo/Symbol; its notes (23:1210) are written for the full Logo. Only code facts are recorded.

Logo/Symbol has no documentation page of its own; its entries are the rules on the Logo documentation page (23:946), which holds the Logo/Symbol set that name Logo/Symbol or its variants. Rules written for the Logo as a whole are not copied.
